transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in today. What brings you into the clinic?

Just... having a hard time, I guess. I feel like I got a motor running inside me all day. If I have to just sit still... like at church, or at home, or even out there in the waiting room... I get to feeling trapped. I just have to get up and do something. So... that's why I came in.
When did you first start experiencing this restless feeling?

About two years... maybe two years and two months. It just... got a lot harder to handle around then. An older relative's health went bad, and I had to take on more responsibilities for them. So... yeah. Since then.
Did you experience this kind of restlessness or trouble sitting still when you were a child?

Yeah... I guess so. Back when I was a boy in school... teachers were always moving my seat around. I just... couldn't stay put. Talked out of turn a lot, I guess. They'd always get mad and I'd get in trouble for jumping up before class was even done. So... yeah. Always been like that.
Do you also struggle with paying attention, organizing your daily tasks, or being easily distracted?

Yeah... I guess. Stuff just gets mixed up. Like... my papers, those appointment cards... even food boxes and notes on my phone. It's just a mess. I can never really figure out what needs doing first... so it usually stays like that until everything is already late. Or just... messed up.
